When appealing for a temp-ban/ban on the Avicus Network please include the following:

  • Why you should be unbanned from the server.: I Believe this was an error because I have not hacked For any reason Let alone this category I was reported and told by that person he reported me after I killed him on neblua *sorry for the spelling on that not sure how you guys spell it* anyways he was sure of him self I hacked * One more thing to add I love this server I first played as puppytlh about 1 year ago and found the game nebla and fell in love with it I loved how it worked and played it nonstop* 
There are some things to think about before making an appeal.
  • Was my temp-ban or ban really false?: Yes

  • Have I waited long enough to be un-banned? : Yes Because I should not have been banned in the first place 
  • Have I been caught ban evading? Ban evading? I dont think so?? *no clue what that is*
  • Have I appealed a ban before? No
  • One more thing the lite loader is a verson of forge if your wondering I tryed it but it did not work for me XD

  • I made a flicker account just for you! :( I hate yahoo...
